scope: Historical Mac state probes and independent phone waveform audits. These are separate evidence sources, not phone state instrumentation.
state_tolerance: For each FP32 tensor, relative RMS < 1e-4 OR maximum absolute error < 1e-5.
waveform_tolerance: Maximum absolute error < 1e-4 AND relative RMS <= 1e-3 (-60 dB).
si_sdr_definition: Mean-centered clean projection; 10 log10(target energy / residual energy).
exact_reset_definition: Each implementation replays its own full four-second waveform and sampled state hashes exactly after reset; baseline and candidate need not be bit-identical to one another.
limits: The Mac probes check all state tensors at six selected frames, not every frame.
No instrumented phone-state or complete sixty-second state comparison was performed.
FP32 reduction association changes explain small numerical differences; no general perceptual equivalence is claimed.
Timing excludes loading, warmup, microphone, echo cancellation, codec, network, jitter buffer and playback.
